newsitem.title: UK: SEVERN TRENT FALLS ON OFWAT SEWERAGE PLAN.
newsitem.headline: SEVERN TRENT FALLS ON OFWAT SEWERAGE PLAN.

text.p: Shares in Severn Trent Plc hit a four-week low on Friday, after water industry regulator Ofwat announced plans to further competition in the provision of sewerage services, traders said.
By 1052 GMT, Severn Trent shares were off 15-1/2p or 1.85 percent at 824-1/2p, amid a mixed sector and moderately lower FTSE 100 index.
Shares in Anglian Water Plc rose 1/2p to 788p, Yorkshire Water lost 3-1/2p to 435p and Thames Water edged up 1-1/2p to 785-1/2p.
Ofwat said it planned to allow Anglian Water to act as a sewerage undertaker for a site currently in Severn Trent's sewerage area.
"If the plan proceeds this will be a major development in furthering competition in the provision of sewerage services," Ofwat said in a statement.
